Tera is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2024 to 2026.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1) and [Web](@/projects/web.md) (1).

Most recently: [korczis.github.io](@/work/korczis-github-io.md): Tomas Korcak (korczis): software that proves its work. Projects, live sites and the stack behind them. Zola + Flowbite Pro on GitHub Pages, supervised by Majordomus; [vomaste.cz](@/work/vomaste-cz.md).

1 of these projects runs as a live site.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Tera: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Tera to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
